correctness.rationale: For a de Finetti mixture with P~Dirichlet(alpha,...,alpha), alpha>0, m>=2, n>=2, conditional iid categorical observations yield E[1_{Xi!=Xi+1}|P]=1-sum_j P_j^2=D. Hence A_n=T_n/(n-1) is conditionally unbiased for latent D and Cov(A_n,D)=Var(D). Dirichlet rising-factorial moments for exponents (2),(4),(2,2),(3) give Var(D)=2alpha(alpha+1)(m-1)/((m alpha+1)^2(m alpha+2)(m alpha+3)). Pair-covariance splits overlapping adjacent edges (1-2S2+S3 conditional) and disjoint edges (conditional independence, unconditional Var(D)), leading to exact Var(T_n) and Corr(A_n,D)=sqrt(2)(n-1)/sqrt(c^2(n-1)+c(7n-9)+2n^2+2n-6), c=m alpha. Algebraic expansion gives Corr=1-(c+1)(c+6)/(4n)+O(n^-2). Independently enumerated exactly 45 cases (m 2,3,4; alpha 1/2,1,3/2; n=2..6) and 20007 sequence states with exact rational posterior moments, confirming formulas. The universal conditional unbiasedness holds for any random finite directing distribution, while closed expressions require symmetric Dirichlet.
